**Context.** The programmes page on aquilacyber.org lists Gurls n Security as not yet launched, described as "a dedicated track supporting and amplifying women in cybersecurity through mentorship, community, and hands-on learning". An earlier draft of the community page said the programme had already run. That was wrong and was removed.

**Needed from the maintainers.** Launch date, how to apply and the page to link to.

**Where to change.** `guides/community.md`, section "What AquilaCyber runs".

**Done when.** The page describes the programme with verified details and a link, and its `Last reviewed` date is updated.
